title: Audit & publish
source: Lesson_5.md (sections 2, 6, 7) - platform v1: export triggered by the teacher
drivingQuestion: How can I critically partner with Artificial Intelligence to build a digital portfolio that authentically represents who I am to the world?

hints.auditRequired: Please confirm you have audited your site to remove all real personal data and AI hallucinations.
hints.reflectionShort: Your answer is too short. Add one more sentence - at least 15 words in English.
hints.reflectionVocab: Use one of today's words in your reflection: publish, export, change, or presentation.
hints.exportGated: The student must complete the final audit and all six reflection questions before the site can be published.
hints.exportVocab: The reflection does not use any of today's words yet (publish, export, change, presentation). Ask the student to add one before publishing.

fields.label: Final Operator Audit
